title: Logical research project record (Projects/<id>/Project.md frontmatter)
description: Editable fields owned by the user and the Connector forms. Unknown properties are preserved. Hierarchy has one displayed level: a project with parent_id cannot itself be a parent, and a project with children cannot be given a parent.

project_type.description: Labels: Thesis, Paper, Simulation, Experiment, Other. New projects default to other; folder connections infer latex→paper and abaqus/isale→simulation. A missing value reads as other.

parent_id.description: Logical project ID of a top-level parent, or null (an empty YAML value also reads as null).
